texts.facts: The petitioner is orally permitted to carry out amendment of the cause title. 2. This petition is filed feeling aggrieved by the action of respondents in calling upon the petitioner to restrict his business hours till 10.00 p.m. everyday. 3. The petitioner is conducting business in the name and style "Woop Natural" ice cream, juice and food items since 2024. The petitioner has obtained a licencee from Food Safety and Standards Authority of India.
texts.arguments: The petitioner has knocked the doors of this Court as the respondents are insisting the petitioner not to conduct his business beyond 10.00 p.m. The petitioner being a citizen having secured licence from the competent authority is entitled to carry out his business as enshrined under Article 19(g) of the Constitution of India. 4. The right to conduct business is a fundamental right guaranteed under Article 19(1)(g) of the Constitution of India, which states that all citizens shall have the right to NC: 2024:KHC-D:9934 practice any profession, or to carry on any occupation, trade, or business. This right, however, is subject to reasonable restrictions that the state may impose in the interest of the general public. The Constitution ensures that a citizen cannot be arbitrarily deprived of their right to carry on a business, provided it is lawful and does not Sri.
